note: Independent re-judgment at HEAD against RFC 7999 Section 3.3 ('The announced prefix is covered by an equal or shorter prefix that the neighboring network is authorized to advertise.'). Verified coveredByAuthorized, blackholeRouteType, and blackholeRouteTypeForBest (rib_blackhole.go) enforce a.Bits() <= route.Bits() && a.Contains(route.Addr()) alongside session agreement and community presence. Positives assert exact routetype.Blackhole on best-path change and Loc-RIB for equal (/24), more-specific (/32), and dynamic-group sessions (TestRFC7999BlackholeHonoredOnAnEqualAuthorizedPrefix, TestBlackholeRouteTypeStampedOnBestPath, TestBlackholeRuleForDynamicGroup, TestBlackholeGroupIdentityArrivesOnAStructuredEvent) and kernel discard in checkRFC7999Blackhole. Negatives hold agreement true and assert exact routetype.Type(0) for a longer /25 authorization over a /24 announcement (TestRFC7999BlackholeRefusedUnderALongerAuthorizedPrefix), an outside prefix (TestBlackholeNotStampedOutsideAuthorization), and positive kernel forwarding in checkRFC7999Blackhole. Q1-Q4 pass.
